console: AURORA_PROGRAM_CONSOLE_READY: UEFI CPL3 upper/note, ASCII, 64-byte lines
Commands depend on the selected profile.
upper   Uppercase a line in a protected Aurora program
write note <text>  Replace the RAM note (53 ASCII bytes)
cat note          Read the note in protected Aurora
upper note        Replace the note with protected uppercase output
write <name> <text>  Write one of four RAM files (8-byte name, 49-byte content)
append <name> <text>  Append to an existing RAM file
copy <source> <destination>  Copy a RAM file; replace destination
cat <name> / upper <name>  Protected read / atomic uppercase replacement
peek <name>        First byte / EOF / missing (file-call profile only)
wc <name>          LF lines / words / bytes (file-call profile only)
crc <name>         CRC32C over the file (file-call profile only)
ls / rm <name>     List / remove RAM files
run <path> [args]  Run a volume or committed program (production only)
